name: ci-full-check-parts
goal: Harness CI Full check finishes well inside its time limit: it runs as parallel parts that together cover every check step, and one aggregate job fails unless all pass

evidence: Linux 'Full check' runs 24 stages serially in one job with timeout-minutes: 120. Passing runs took 87-117 min (jobs 140349985966=110, 140282751215=111, 140196878633=117); jobs 140339573776, 140317562796, 140284900292 and 140178726202 were cancelled at 120. Stage times: test:unit 21-27, test:e2e 38-47, build+test:package 14-17, check:desktop 17-18, reports 5-6, hub 6.5. Expected: the check finishes well inside its limit and still runs every stage.

test/ci-native-verify.test.ts pinned timeout-minutes: 120 and the single 'bun run check' command, so it fixed the limit but said nothing about headroom or how stages are divided. The strengthened test pins parallel parts with a 60 minute limit each, matrix == checkParts, an always() gate named Full check, full stage coverage and part selection.
